description:
"My new [La Familia V2] frame is full of personal touches – from the specs, angles, and artwork – and I really feel at home riding it. Because I ride all terrain, I chose to make the specs work for every style of riding. For the artwork, Mongoose gave me full creative control which was super fun for me… I used to draw those similar icons on everything Ha-ha. A big thank you to Mongoose for the opportunity, and excited for everyone to get their hands on one." – KP
Signature BMX frame of Mongoose pro rider / 3-time X Games Gold Medalist Kevin Peraza.
Frame specs and graphics designed by Mongoose pro Kevin Peraza himself. One size, top tube 20.75”, chain stay 13”, head tube angle 75.5 ̊, seat tube angle 71 ̊. Weight 5 lb 1 oz. Fits 20" wheels.
Heat-treated, double-butted 4130 chromoly tubing with internal (top tube) & external (down tube) gussets, external machined seat tube with integrated seat clamp, and dent-resistant chainstays. Designed to withstand any trick Kevin Peraza dreams up.
Removable brake hardware makes it easy to use your setup of choice. Integrated chain tensioners in the dropouts for added convenience.
Compatible parts for the frame include: 14mm rear axle, sealed bearing mid BB, and a 41.8mm integrated sealed bearing headset.
